adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw` when that mode is set (app/models/post.rb), which bypasses the normal cooking pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook`) that typically performs rendering/sanitization. The new import path sets this mode specifically for embedded/RSS imports (`PostCreator.new(... cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], skip_validations: true)` in app/models/topic_embed.rb), and the embed view renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Feed content in Jobs::PollFeed comes from RSS `i.content` and is only HTML-unescaped/scrubbed, not sanitized. This combination creates a real XSS/content-safety defect: imported HTML can be stored and rendered without sanitization/validation.
